skills.reference_body: Build only from authorized, verifiable client or project evidence covering context, baseline, intervention, responsibilities, timeline, constraints, measures, results, attribution, limitations, quotations, confidentiality, and approval. Separate fact from interpretation and correlation from causation. Reconcile metrics to source records, obtain permission for names, logos, and testimonials, protect sensitive information, and preserve a source-to-claim evidence map.
skills.asset_body:
# Case Study

## Client or project, audience, objective, owner, confidentiality, and approval

| Claim | Source evidence | Period | Attribution | Limitation | Approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Context, baseline, challenge, intervention, responsibilities, and timeline

## Outcomes, measures, quotations, visuals, rights, and caveats

## Review, publication channels, expiration, version, and archive
skills.recovery: If permission, source records, attribution, metric definitions, confidentiality, quotation accuracy, or approval is unresolved, anonymize or remove the affected claim and keep the case study unpublished.
skills.recovery_scenario: Case study claims or permissions are incomplete.
